title: "liempieza de datos definitiva para DAGs"
format: html

```{r}
library(bnlearn)
```


```{r}
data= read.csv("C:/Users/tamar/OneDrive/Documents/5to semestre/Análisis de métodos de razonamiento e incertidumbre/retoReal/bayesian-networks-enmt/enmt_unam_updated.csv")
```






```{r}
#se genera dataframe con variables necesarias 
data <- data[, c("p9", "estrato", "Tam_loc", "sexo", "edad_1", "escol",
  "h21_1", "ing_fam", "cond_act", "p1b_12", "p13", "p26", "p6",
  "ing_ind", "p1a")
]
```

```{r}
dim(data) #se verifica que se haya cargado bien 
```
```{r}

#se genera la primera DAG 
dag1= empty.graph(nodes=c("p9", "estrato", "Tam_loc", "sexo", "edad_1", "escol",
  "h21_1", "ing_fam", "cond_act", "p1b_12", "p13", "p26", "p6",
  "ing_ind", "p1a"))


```

```{r}
#se definen arcos de dag1 
arc_set1 =matrix(c("sexo", "escol",
                 "escol", "cond_act",
                 "cond_act", "ing_ind",
                 "edad_1", "ing_ind", 
                 "ing_ind", "ing_fam", 
                 "h21_1", "ing_fam", 
                 "Tam_loc", "estrato", 
                 "ing_fam", "p6", 
                 "p6", "p13", 
                 "p6", "p1a", 
                 "estrato", "p1a", 
                 "p13", "p26", 
                 "p26", "p1a", 
                 "p1b_12", "p1a", 
                 "p1a", "p9"),
               byrow=TRUE, ncol=2,
               dimnames=list(NULL,c("from", "to")))
                 
  
#  "sale", "entra" 
```

```{r}
#se guardan arcos en dag1
arcs(dag1)=arc_set1
```

```{r}
graphviz.plot(dag1, shape="ellipse") #se verficia que se haya cargado la info bien 

```
```{r}
#preparacion de datos 

# Discretiza y elimina nan
data_discreta <- data.frame(lapply(data, as.factor))
# Elimina las filas que tengan al menos un NA
data_discreta <- na.omit(data_discreta)


```


```{r} 
#se ajusta red bn_mle1 a la dag1 por mle 
bn_mle1 = bn.fit(dag1, data=data_discreta, method = "mle")

```

```{r}
#fuerzas entre arcos de red1/dag1
arc.strength(dag1, data = data_discreta, criterion = "mi")

```
```{r}
score(dag1, data = data_discreta, type = "bic")
score(dag1, data= data_discreta, type= "aic")

```




The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
